# TIRA Sports

> TIRA (app store name "TIRA Sports") is a free team app for community sport.
> Coaches, players and parents get one schedule for the team, answer Going,
> Maybe or Can't for each event, and TIRA sends the reminders. Free for teams,
> players and families, with no ads. Made in Aotearoa New Zealand, for teams in
> New Zealand, Australia and the United Kingdom. Available on iPhone and Android.

## Sports
Football, rugby, netball, cricket, hockey, basketball, volleyball, badminton,
water polo, and any other sport. Groups that don't play games (rides, walks,
working bees) can use it as an activity group.

## What every team gets
- Schedule: trainings, games and events with the venue, notes and a map link.
  A whole season's fixture list can be pasted in at once, and events can repeat
  every week or fortnight.
- Availability: players and parents answer Going, Maybe or Can't with one tap.
- Reminders: 3 days, 1 day and 2 hours before an event to anyone who hasn't
  answered, and a "starting soon" reminder 1 hour before.
- Updates and team chat, with replies, mentions, reactions and quick polls.
- Works at a ground with no signal, showing what was saved when last online.

## Features a coach can switch on in Team settings
- Share availability (first names only)
- Close availability early for a game
- Volunteer roles (scorer, referee or umpire, oranges, snacks)
- Coordinate rides
- Record results, an MVP for each game, and a season record
- Game day lineup for cricket (batting order, captain, keeper, opening bowlers)
- Fixtures from PlayHQ, for clubs that run competitions on PlayHQ

## Children's privacy
- A child is registered with first name and date of birth only. No surname, no photo.
- Emergency contacts and medical notes are locked. Coaches see them only if a
  parent turns it on, and every look is logged. Medical notes are encrypted.
- Parents can see, change or delete their child's details at any time.
- No ads, and personal data is never sold.

## Cost
Free for teams, players and families. Local businesses can become partners,
and anyone can donate to help keep TIRA free.
